paper_title: RedWhale An Adapted Korean LLM Through Efficient Continual Pretraining
caption: : Model complexity analysis.
model_annotation: This line plot, titled "Model complexity analysis," illustrates the relationship between vocabulary size and two distinct complexity metrics: "Input Complexity" and "Embedding Complexity," both represented as a "Scaled Ratio." The horizontal x-axis, labeled "Vocab Size," ranges from approximately 8,000 to 40,000, with major tick marks at intervals of 5,000. The vertical y-axis, labeled "Scaled Ratio," spans from 0.0 to 1.0, with major grid lines at 0.2 intervals. Two lines are plotted: the blue line with circular markers, representing "Input Complexity," starts at a Scaled Ratio of 1.0 when the Vocab Size is around 8,000 and exhibits a steady, near-linear decline, reaching a value of approximately 0.07 at a Vocab Size of 40,000. The teal line with circular markers, representing "Embedding Complexity," begins at a Scaled Ratio of 0.0 at the same starting Vocab Size and shows a steady, near-linear increase, reaching a value of 1.0 at a Vocab Size of 40,000. The two lines intersect at a Vocab Size of approximately 20,000, where both metrics have a Scaled Ratio of 0.4.
